chunks: It is necessary for you to recall what passed for those who preceded you:
be it a just government, or a noble tradition, or a precedent from our Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), or an obligatory command in the Book of Allah,
so that you may follow what you have seen us acting upon in them, and exert yourself in following what I have enjoined upon you in this document of mine,
in which I have exhausted my plea against you, so that you may have no excuse when your soul hastens to its passion.
ai.seo_question: What are the key principles of governance and self-accountability outlined in Imam Ali's letter to Malik al-Ashtar?
ai.summary: This directive anchors Malik al-Ashtar’s governance in the continuity of divine and prophetic precedent, emphasizing that adherence to the covenant serves as a bulwark against the tyranny of *al-nafs* (the self). By recalling established precedents of justice and piety, the Imam ensures that Malik’s administrative actions remain grounded in objective religious authority rather than subjective whims, a core tenet of Shia political ethics.
